info.title: StudyFlow API
info.description: Courses, assignments and study tracking for students.

get.description: Which optional features this deployment has, so the app only offers working ones.

post.description: Log in as the shared demo account, rebuilding its data first if it's over an hour old.

Swap the refresh cookie for a new access token (and a new refresh cookie).

The app calls this when it loads, and whenever its 15-minute access token runs out.
End this device's session. Its access token stops working at once, too.
End every session this account has, on every device: for a lost laptop or a leaked token.
New password. Every *other* login is ended (this device stays in), as are any reset links.
Send a confirmation link to the new address. Nothing changes until it's clicked.

schema.title: Response Change Email Api Account Email Post

post.description:
The link from the email. Needs no login: the token is the proof, and it can be opened on
whichever device the email arrived on.

Email a reset link. The answer is the same whether or not the account exists, so this
can't be used to find out who has one.

schema.title: Response Request Password Reset Api Account Password Reset Post

post.description:
Set a new password from a reset link, and log out every device: if someone else had
the old password, they're out too.

Delete the account and everything in it. Courses you own go for their members too; your
progress in courses you joined goes, but those courses stay for everyone else.

POST, not DELETE: it needs the password in a body, and DELETE bodies get dropped by some
proxies and clients.

get.description: Your own courses and the ones you've joined.

schema.title: Response List Courses Api Courses Get

delete.description: Delete the course for everyone in it. Members who only want out should leave instead.

post.description:
Turn the invite link on, or replace it: the old link stops working at once (people who
already joined stay in).

get.description: Everyone in the course, owner first. Anyone in it can see who else is.

schema.title: Response List Members Api Courses  Course Id  Members Get

delete.description:
Leave a course (your own id), or, as its owner, remove someone from it.

Their status, marks and study sessions for this course go with them: they were about a
course they can no longer see.

get.description: What the link is for, before you join. You must be logged in: the link isn't public.

post.description: Join the course. Joining twice is harmless; the owner can't join their own course.

schema.title: Response List Assignments Api Assignments Get

post.description: Create a weekly repeating deadline: one row per due date, all sharing a series_id.

schema.title: Response Create Series Api Assignments Series Post

patch.description:
Change this deadline and every later one in its series.

A new due_at moves each of them by the same wall-clock change (e.g. "Fridays 23:59" to
"Mondays 09:00"), and "{n}" in a new title is numbered by position in the series.

parameters.name: tz

schema.description: Time zone the due-time change is in
schema.title: Tz

parameters.description: Time zone the due-time change is in

schema.title: Response Update Following Api Assignments  Assignment Id  Following Patch

delete.description: Delete this deadline and every later one in its series (the earlier ones stay).

patch.description:
Edit a deadline. The shared fields change for everyone in the course; status and the
mark change only for you.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Study Sessions Get

get.description:
Study time per day and per course for the 7 days starting at `start`.

"Which day" depends on where the student is: 22:00 Monday in Toronto is already Tuesday in
UTC. So the client sends its time zone, and days are computed in that zone. A session counts
on the day it started.

parameters.name: start

schema.description: First day of the week, e.g. a Monday
schema.title: Start

parameters.description: First day of the week, e.g. a Monday

post.description: Turn the feed on, or replace its URL with a new one: the old URL stops working at once.

get.description:
The user's deadlines as iCalendar, for Google, Apple or Outlook calendar to subscribe to.

No login: calendar apps can't send one, so the secret in the URL is the credential. An
unknown, replaced or switched-off token gets a 404, like a feed that never existed.

Every course's grade so far, its possible range, and what's needed for each letter grade.

Only deadlines with a weight count. The weights are the course's; the marks are this user's
own (in a shared course, everyone sees their own grade). Computed on request from the stored
marks, so it can never disagree with them.
